newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Poisoned mushrooms kill 77 people in Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: Poisoned mushrooms kill 77 people in Ukraine.

text.p: Poisoned mushrooms have killed 77 in Ukraine this year and 10 to 25 new cases of mushroom poisoning are reported every day, the government said on Friday.
Nearly half the victims were children, a statement said, and most of the victims were unaware they had picked poisonous varieties.
The statement gave no comparisons for cases of poisoning last year. Autumn mushroom picking is both a popular pastime in UKraine and an easy way for impoverished families to make ends meet.
Hundreds of people die each year in Ukraine from various types of food poisoning, often contracted from goods bought at unregulated open air markets.
